lines: This scholarship programme offers financial support of a maximum of £10,000 to students pursuing one-year postgraduate study in the UK.
Need some further guidance? We're here to help.

In partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign, University of Hull is offering 4 scholarships to students in Bangladesh, Indonesia, Kenya and Mexico applying for one-year postgraduate courses in September 2026.

The GREAT Scholarships 2026 programme, launched by the British Council together with over 60 UK universities, supports postgraduate students from Bangladesh, China, Egypt, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Thailand, Turkey, and Vietnam in accessing world-class UK higher education opportunities.

The scholarship programme offers financial support of a maximum of £10,000 to students pursuing one-year postgraduate study in the UK. Students can apply for courses in a range of subjects, at over 60 institutions across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

Please note that applicants must be permanent residents and passport holders of Bangladesh, China (mainland only), Egypt, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Thailand, Turkey, or Vietnam. For more information on the GREAT Scholarships 2026, please visit
The University of Hull is offering scholarships for students beginning a full-time, postgraduate taught programme (excluding PGCert and PGDip) starting in September 2026.
One successful applicant in each of the categories listed below will receive an award of £10,000 (GBP) in the form of a tuition fee reduction.
1 x Bangladeshi student studying any full-time, Hull-based postgraduate taught programme.
1 x Indonesian student studying any full-time, Hull-based postgraduate taught programme.
1 x Kenyan student studying any full-time, Hull-based postgraduate taught programme.
1 x Mexican student studying any full-time, Hull-based postgraduate taught programme.
Successful applicants will be required to pay a £4,000 tuition fee deposit to secure their place on their programme.
To be eligible for a University of Hull – GREAT Scholarship 2026 - all applicants must:
Be a passport holder and resident of one of the respective countries included within this scholarship.
Have received an offer of study for a postgraduate taught degree programme (excluding PGCert and PGDip) at the University of Hull.
Have achieved, or be working towards, a 2:1 degree or equivalent in their undergraduate programme recognised by the University of Hull.
Have achieved an IELTS of at least 6.5 overall, with 5.5 in each skill or equivalent before the application deadline.
Have not previously studied in the UK.
Have completed a University of Hull – GREAT Scholarship 2026 application form and have answered the following questions (maximum of 250-words per question):
What skills and knowledge have you gained to date and how will they help you to achieve success in your chosen field of study?
How does the course you have applied for at the University of Hull fit with your interests and future plans, and how will the qualification enhance your career?
What extra-curricular activities have you engaged in and how has this contributed to your personal development?
How will the knowledge and leadership skills you acquire as a student of the University of Hull enhance the development of your country?
